messages:
Leah: opened a tiny PR to clarify limits and add a short compatibility note for aurora-mini variants. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512

Marco: saw it, thanks. does this change the recommended batch sizes in the limits table?

Leah: adjusted batch guidance: 1-4 for low-latency, 8-16 for throughput on Dedicated. left a note that quantized variants can increase memory but may affect KV cache behavior.

Marco: can you add a one-line migration snippet for the SDK? people often copy it.

Leah: added sync and async examples. sync snippet uses `client.generate`, async uses `stream_generate`. also added a short console link fix (/console/models/aurora-mini).

docs-bot: CI: link-check passed; lint flagged line wrap on examples.md

Leah: wrapped line, pushed.

security: quick read - wording ok but avoid stating we manage customer keys. changed to "customer-managed KMS" in the Private section.

Leah: thanks, updated. merging after Marco approval.

Marco: LGTM, merging. changelog: clarified limits and compatibility, added SDK snippets and console link fix.

Leah: follow-up: will add two small prompts to examples repo for QA (ticket INTERNAL-1210).
